name: Alert message
description: Dismissable site-wide alert banners modelled as content entities, with role/user targeting and cron-driven scheduling.
project_description: Alert Message provides a lightweight, dismissable alert/notification banner for a Drupal site. Each alert is a content entity (entity type `alert_message`) with a label, a formatted message body, optional targeting by user role and/or individual user, and a publish/unpublish date pair. Alerts are rendered by a single core Block plugin (`alert_message`) that you place in a region; the block uses a lazy builder so it can be cached, filters the loaded (enabled) alerts by the current user's roles and uid, and renders each as an entity view. Dismissal is per-browser-session and entirely client-side: a small JS behaviour records the dismissed alert's id in an `alertMessageClosed` cookie and removes the element; a page-cache request policy denies the Internal Page Cache when that cookie is present so the Dynamic Page Cache serves a per-cookie variant. Scheduling is cron-driven: `hook_cron` re-saves alerts whose start time has arrived, and each save's `preSave()` sets the boolean `status` from the publish/unpublish window (a validation constraint rejects an unpublish date that is in the past or before the publish date). The module ships an entity list builder, an add/edit form, a near-empty settings page (a placeholder pointing you at Field UI), overridable Twig templates (`alert-message.html.twig`, `block--alert-messages.html.twig`), and the Entity API contrib module's granular per-entity permissions.
